title: Ha Long Bay
content:
The limestone islands of Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1994, seen from a boat, and Sửng Sốt cave on Bồ Hòn island.

Demo day with no recorded route. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
